messages.subject: Socket Bind Error
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run my App (ui.R and server.R) files from my own computer and I get the socket bind error message
Any help on how I can overcome this?

Warning in .SOCK_SERVE(port) : R-Websockets(tcpserv): bind() failed
Error in createContext(port, webpage, is.binary = is.binary) :
  Unable to bind socket on port 8100; is it already in use?

Thanks!

messages.author: 5e64ab44fa760521
messages.subject: Re: Socket Bind Error
parts:
Sometimes it is faster just to open a new port:

R -e “shiny::runApp(port=8101)" # 8100 is the default port number

very useful if you are working on or using more than one shiny app at the same time (just assign a different port to each one of them).
